children: AerCap Holdings' board has authorized a $1 billion share-repurchase plan.

The buyback plan extends through June 30, 2027. During that time, AerCap may buy its ordinary shares through open-market purchases or privately negotiated transactions, in accordance with applicable U.S. federal securities laws.
The company said Wednesday that the timing and exact number of repurchases will be determined by the management team, depending upon market conditions and other factors.
The program, which can be discontinued at any time, will be funded using cash on hand, as well as cash generated from operations, it added.
